title: Implement DDL preview UI with user confirmation
description: Create the UI to display generated DDL to the user and require explicit confirmation before execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated DDL is displayed to user before execution
User must explicitly confirm before DDL is executed
No DDL is executed without user confirmation

evidence: Created src/ddl/ddlGenerator.ts — Frontend DDL generation module porting TASK-043 backend logic (CREATE TABLE, PK, FK, UNIQUE constraints, indexes; quoted identifiers; no DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE; throws on unsupported types)

Created src/ddl/ddlGenerator.test.ts — 9 unit tests covering CREATE TABLE generation, column types/nullability, inline PK, FK constraints, identifier quoting, no destructive statements, empty diagram, unsupported type errors, deterministic output, tables-first ordering
Created src/connection/ddlApi.ts — API client for POST /api/apply-schema with configurable fetch for testing; sends ddl + connection config + confirm flag
Created src/connection/ddlApi.test.ts — 6 unit tests covering confirm=true/false, non-ok responses, network errors, custom API URL

Created src/components/DdlPreview.tsx — Modal dialog showing generated DDL in code block; explicit confirmation checkbox required before Execute DDL button is enabled; never sends DDL without confirmation; success/error result messages; accessibility (role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, explicit label for checkbox)

Created src/components/DdlPreview.test.tsx — 12 unit tests covering modal visibility, DDL display, confirmation gating, no applyDDL without confirmation, confirm=true payload, success/error messages, Cancel handler, null connection handling
Modified src/App.tsx — Added 'Export to PostgreSQL' button (visible only when connected); integrates DdlPreview modal with diagram and connection config
Modified src/index.css — Added styles for DdlPreview modal body, code container, confirmation checkbox, action buttons, result messages (success/error)

Acceptance criteria addressed: (1) Generated DDL displayed in code block before execution, (2) User must explicitly check confirmation checkbox before Execute DDL is enabled, (3) applyDDL is never called without confirm=true; button disabled until checked

Reviewed implementation files: src/ddl/ddlGenerator.ts, src/ddl/ddlGenerator.test.ts, src/connection/ddlApi.ts, src/connection/ddlApi.test.ts, src/components/DdlPreview.tsx, src/components/DdlPreview.test.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/index.css.

Ran unit tests inside Docker container (image node:20-alpine) per docker-test-runner skill: docker run --rm --init --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 512 --memory 2g --shm-size 1g --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --tmpfs /tmp -e HOME=/tmp -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/.npm -v <project>:/work:rw -w /work --name task-044-review node:20-alpine sh -c "npx vitest run src/ddl/ddlGenerator.test.ts src/connection/ddlApi.test.ts src/components/DdlPreview.test.tsx".
Test results: 14 failed / 13 passed / 27 total; 2 test files failed, 1 passed (ddlApi.test.ts 5/5 passed).

BLOCKER (implementation bug): src/components/DdlPreview.tsx:72 — useEffect dependency array [isOpen, generate] references generate, but generate is declared with const on line 74 (after the useEffect). Temporal dead zone throws ReferenceError: Cannot access 'generate' before initialization, crashing DdlPreview on mount. All 12 DdlPreview tests fail, so acceptance criteria (DDL displayed before execution; explicit confirmation required; no DDL without confirmation) cannot be verified. Fix: declare generate before useEffect (or remove generate from the dependency array).

src/ddl/ddlGenerator.test.ts — test assertion mismatches (not implementation defects): (1) expects "id" SERIAL NOT NULL but implementation emits "id" SERIAL PRIMARY KEY (SERIAL implies NOT NULL in PostgreSQL; implementation deliberately omits redundant NOT NULL). (2) not.toContain('DELETE') false-positives on ON DELETE NO ACTION FK referential action (not a destructive DELETE statement). Reconcile these test assertions with correct PostgreSQL behavior.

Architectural assessment: DDL generation (tables-first, quoted identifiers, no DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE), ddlApi client (confirm flag, configurable fetch, error handling), App.tsx integration (Export to PostgreSQL button visible only when connected), and confirmation-gating design are sound in principle. However, the DdlPreview TDZ crash blocks the feature. Requesting changes; return to implementer to fix the crash and reconcile the two ddlGenerator test assertions before re-review.
Fixes applied (commit 9888e9e on ticket/TASK-044, pushed to origin/ticket/TASK-044; trunk is main; nothing committed to main):

(1) src/components/DdlPreview.tsx — moved the `generate` useCallback before the `useEffect` that calls it, eliminating the temporal-dead-zone ReferenceError ('Cannot access generate before initialization') that crashed DdlPreview on mount and failed all 12 DdlPreview tests.

(2) src/ddl/ddlGenerator.test.ts — reconciled assertions with PostgreSQL behavior: expects "id" SERIAL PRIMARY KEY (SERIAL implies NOT NULL; implementation correctly omits redundant NOT NULL); replaced not.toContain('DELETE') with a statement-prefix check so ON DELETE NO ACTION FK referential actions no longer false-positive as destructive DELETE statements.
(3) src/ddl/ddlGenerator.ts — renderDefault now emits SQL keywords CURRENT_TIMESTAMP/CURRENT_DATE unquoted (DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, not DEFAULT 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP').

(4) src/connection/ddlApi.ts — exported DEFAULT_API_URL; src/components/DdlPreview.tsx — passes DEFAULT_API_URL explicitly to applyDDL(ddl, connection, true, DEFAULT_API_URL) and reports generation errors as "Failed to generate DDL: <detail>".

(5) src/components/DdlPreview.test.tsx — corrected TEST_DDL fixture to "id" SERIAL PRIMARY KEY; replaced the unobservable transient loading-state assertion with "starts DDL generation when the modal opens" (generateDdlMock called once on open).

Acceptance criteria: (1) generated DDL displayed in a read-only code block before execution; (2) Execute DDL button disabled until the explicit confirmation checkbox is checked; (3) applyDDL is never called without confirm=true (button gating + confirm=true payload verified by tests).
